summary: Separate the bounded observation window from actual collector completion elapsed, retaining sample offsets and real admitted CPU endpoint timing. A final CPU probe crossing expiry keeps its measured endpoint; the subsequent lifetime RSS probe is not started after cutoff.
API: ResourceSeries.duration_seconds is the interval from start to CPU endpoint if admitted, otherwise report assembly, intersected with the observer duration and optional trial deadline. CollectorAccounting.wall_seconds is actual elapsed through report assembly and may exceed the work window. CPU wall_seconds is actual CPU endpoint elapsed when observed, possibly beyond the window, or the observation window when no final endpoint exists. ResourceSeries validates that CPU wall does not precede its window, rather than requiring equality. Limits and work admission are unchanged.
